_readme: Append one object to 'winners' each month (newest first). The site renders newest-to-oldest automatically. Object shape: { "month": "2026-07", "label": "July", "nftId": "0005-0105" (must match an id in collection.json — thumb/title are looked up from there), "wallet": "the wallet holding the NFT at draw time (rendered as a static, non-updating record)", "draw": { "blockNumber": 430944946, "blockUrl": "https://explorer.solana.com/block/...", "blockHash": "...", "hex": "block hash converted to hex", "winnerNumber": 5 }, "prize": "optional, e.g. 40,100 $401jK", "announcementUrl": "optional https://x.com/... or Reddit post URL", "platform": "optional 'x' or 'reddit'", "reactionEmbedUrl": "optional X/Reddit post URL to embed inline" }. While 'winners' is empty, the site shows a 'first draw' coming-soon state using firstDraw from raffle.json.
